title: TomoSTAR: seismic travel-time and attenuation tomography from the command line
description: TomoSTAR is a standalone, cross-platform program for local earthquake tomography: automatic picking, hypocentre relocation, minimum 1-D models, Vp, Vs and Vp/Vs travel-time tomography with fast-marching rays in spherical geometry on regular grids or adaptive octree cells, Q tomography from t*, L-curves, synthetic resolution tests and the exact resolution matrix, standard deviations and resolution lengths on adaptive cells, with SIMD, OpenCL and MPI and scriptable pipelines.
